correctness.rationale: Gradient initialization implies z_c=e_c+d e_d identically, reducing the true primal dynamics to stated 3x3 A(λ,d). Independent symbolic charpoly gives z³−λ z²+λ(λ−1−d²)z+λd². Schur/Jury cubic tests reduce strictly to J>0 in λ,d∈(-1,1), and negativity at J=0 gives a unit-modulus complex pair; the span of v1,v2,A v2 with determinant λ−1 proves necessity for actual initialized trajectories, not just arbitrary tracker states. Independent exact boundary at λ=−1/2 and signs on either side confirmed. No extension to arbitrary steps or general networks.
